description: This file defines a class CountersGrain implementing an Orleans grain with event sourcing capabilities. It manages counters identified by string keys, supports updating, resetting, and retrieving counter states, and contains nested classes for state and events.

classes.name: CountersGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that uses event sourcing to manage counter states, allowing updates, resets, and retrieval of counter data.

classes.name: CountersGrain.GrainState
classes.description: A nested class representing the state of the grain, primarily a dictionary mapping string keys to integer counts, with methods to apply events.

classes.name: CountersGrain.UpdatedEvent
classes.description: An event class indicating an update to a specific counter key.

classes.name: CountersGrain.ResetAllEvent
classes.description: An event class indicating a reset of all counters.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initialization method called when the grain is activated; in this case, it performs no asynchronous setup.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Raises an event to update a counter by a specified amount, with optional confirmation of persistence.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Raises an event to reset all counters, with optional confirmation.

methods.name: ConfirmAllPreviouslyRaisedEvents
methods.description: Confirms all events that have been raised but not yet persisted.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative (unconfirmed) count for a specific key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Returns the tentative state of all counters as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Returns the confirmed state of all counters as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: GetAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all confirmed events from the event log.
